column4: US-01 Create GitHub repo with frontend and backend folders
column5:
As the developer, I want a GitHub repository with frontend and backend folders so that all work is versioned.

Acceptance criteria:
Repo created; prototype in /frontend; empty Express app in /backend; README with run steps.

Owner: Member 4
Reviewer: Member 3

column4: US-02 Set up Jira Scrum board, backlog and sprints
column5:
As the developer, I want a Jira Scrum board with the backlog and sprints so that progress is visible to my instructor.

Acceptance criteria:
Backlog imported; Sprints 5-14 created with dates; instructor can view the board.

Owner: Member 1
Reviewer: Member 2

column4: US-03 Express project with MySQL connection pool and .env
column5:
As the developer, I want an Express project connected to MySQL through a connection pool so that the API can read and write data.

Acceptance criteria:
Server starts with npm start; DB settings come from .env; .env is in .gitignore.

Owner: Member 3
Reviewer: Member 2

column4: US-04 Health endpoint and standard JSON error handler
column5:
As the developer, I want a health endpoint and one error handler so that every error returns the same JSON shape.

Acceptance criteria:
GET /api/v1/health returns 200; errors return {error:{code,message,fields}} with correct status codes.

Owner: Member 5
Reviewer: Member 2

column4: US-05 Write OpenAPI 3 specification for all endpoints
column5:
As the developer, I want an OpenAPI 3 specification of every endpoint so that the API is designed before it is coded.

Acceptance criteria:
All 17 endpoints with request/response schemas, status codes, error format and JWT security described.

Owner: Member 4
Reviewer: Member 2

column4: US-06 Serve Swagger UI at /api/docs
column5:
As the instructor, I want to browse the API in Swagger UI so that I can review the API design.

Acceptance criteria:
Swagger UI served at /api/docs from the OpenAPI file.

Owner: Member 1
Reviewer: Member 2

column4: US-07 Admin login API with bcrypt and JWT
column5:
As an admin, I want to log in with my email and password so that only authorised staff reach the admin area.

Acceptance criteria:
POST /auth/login checks bcrypt hash; returns JWT valid 8 hours; wrong login returns 401; last_login_at updated.

Owner: Member 3
Reviewer: Member 5

column4: US-08 Protect admin endpoints with JWT middleware
column5:
As the system, I want every /admin endpoint to require a valid JWT so that student and admin areas stay separate.

Acceptance criteria:
Missing or expired token returns 401; inactive admin returns 403.

Owner: Member 1
Reviewer: Member 4

column4: US-09 Lookups API: categories, options, batches, sections
column5:
As a student, I want the forms to load categories, options, batches and sections from the database so that the lists are always current.

Acceptance criteria:
GET /lookups returns active categories with options and descriptions, batches and sections.

Owner: Member 4
Reviewer: Member 1

column4: US-10 Connect admin login page and logout to API
column5:
As an admin, I want the login page to use the API so that the simulated login is replaced by real authentication.

Acceptance criteria:
Login page calls API, stores token, shows error on 401; Log out clears token; admin pages redirect when no token.

Owner: Member 2
Reviewer: Member 1

column4: US-11 Load form dropdowns from lookups API
column5:
As a student, I want the form dropdowns filled from the API so that I choose from the department's real lists.

Acceptance criteria:
Category, option (with description), batch and section dropdowns load from /lookups.

Owner: Member 1
Reviewer: Member 5

column4: US-12 Submit anonymous complaint API with tracking reference
column5:
As an anonymous student, I want to submit a complaint and get a tracking reference so that I can follow it without revealing who I am.

Acceptance criteria:
Option must belong to category; unique SVP-XXXXXX generated (retry on clash); complaint and first history row saved in one transaction; no identity stored.

Owner: Member 5
Reviewer: Member 4

column4: US-13 Submit identified complaint API with student details
column5:
As an identified student, I want to submit a complaint with my details so that the department can follow up with me.

Acceptance criteria:
Reg no, batch, section, class timing and 20-1000 char description validated on the server; student created or updated; returns tracking reference.

Owner: Member 2
Reviewer: Member 5

column4: US-14 Connect complaint forms and success page to API
column5:
As a student, I want the complaint forms and success page to use the API so that my complaint is really saved.

Acceptance criteria:
Both forms post to the API; server validation errors appear under the right field; success page shows returned reference.

Owner: Member 3
Reviewer: Member 4

column4: US-15 Track complaint by reference API
column5:
As a student, I want to track my complaint by reference so that I can see its progress and the department's response.

Acceptance criteria:
GET /track/{ref} returns status, timeline from status_history, latest note and current meeting; unknown ref returns 404; never returns identity.

Owner: Member 5
Reviewer: Member 3

column4: US-16 Connect track and status pages to API
column5:
As a student, I want the track and status pages to use the API so that I see live data.

Acceptance criteria:
Track page calls API; status page shows timeline, response and meeting from API data.

Owner: Member 1
Reviewer: Member 3

column4: US-17 Admin queue API with filters and pagination
column5:
As an admin, I want a submission queue with filters so that I can find complaints quickly.

Acceptance criteria:
GET /admin/complaints filters by category, status, type, date range and reference search; 20 per page; newest first.

Owner: Member 2
Reviewer: Member 3

column4: US-18 Connect queue page and dashboard to API
column5:
As an admin, I want the queue and dashboard to show live data so that I work on real complaints.

Acceptance criteria:
Queue filters call the API; dashboard cards and recent list load from the API.

Owner: Member 4
Reviewer: Member 3

column4: US-19 Complaint details API (identity hidden if anonymous)
column5:
As an admin, I want to open a complaint's details so that I can review it.

Acceptance criteria:
GET /admin/complaints/{id} returns full details; identity fields absent for anonymous complaints.

Owner: Member 3
Reviewer: Member 1

column4: US-20 Change status API with transition rules and history
column5:
As an admin, I want to change a complaint's status so that the student sees progress.

Acceptance criteria:
Allowed: Received to Under Review or Rejected; Under Review to Resolved or Rejected; Resolved or Rejected back to Under Review. Other moves return 422. History row written in the same transaction.

Owner: Member 1
Reviewer: Member 5

column4: US-21 Assign staff API and staff list
column5:
As an admin, I want to assign a staff member so that someone owns the complaint.

Acceptance criteria:
PATCH /staff accepts an active staff id or null (Unassigned); GET /admin/staff lists active staff.

Owner: Member 2
Reviewer: Member 1

column4: US-22 Add resolution note API
column5:
As an admin, I want to add a resolution note so that the student gets a response.

Acceptance criteria:
POST /notes requires 10-500 characters; saves author and time; newest note shown to student.

Owner: Member 4
Reviewer: Member 5

column4: US-23 Connect details page actions to API
column5:
As an admin, I want the details page actions to use the API so that my changes are saved.

Acceptance criteria:
Change status, assign staff and add note modals call the API and refresh the page; errors shown in the modal.

Owner: Member 5
Reviewer: Member 4

column4: US-24 Propose meeting API (identified complaints only)
column5:
As an admin, I want to propose a meeting for an identified complaint so that we can discuss it in person.

Acceptance criteria:
Rejected with 422 for anonymous complaints; date not in the past; location 3-100 chars; response starts as No Response.

Owner: Member 1
Reviewer: Member 5

column4: US-25 Student confirm or reschedule meeting API
column5:
As a student, I want to confirm a meeting or ask for another time so that the meeting suits me.

Acceptance criteria:
Confirm sets Confirmed and time; request needs future date and time; confirming after a request removes the request first.

Owner: Member 2
Reviewer: Member 5

column4: US-26 Connect student and admin meeting pages to API
column5:
As student and admin, I want the meeting pages to use the API so that responses are shared.

Acceptance criteria:
Student meeting page and admin meetings page with response filter load and save through the API.

Owner: Member 4
Reviewer: Member 1

column4: US-27 Analytics API and live dashboard
column5:
As an admin, I want live analytics so that I can report on complaints.

Acceptance criteria:
GET /admin/analytics reads the five database views; dashboard and analytics pages show totals, status, category, monthly volume, resolution rate and class timing.

Owner: Member 3
Reviewer: Member 4

column4: US-28 Host MySQL database on Aiven
column5:
As the developer, I want a hosted MySQL database so that the live site has real data.

Acceptance criteria:
Aiven free MySQL created; schema.sql and sample_data.sql run; integrity tests pass on it.

Owner: Member 4
Reviewer: Member 2

column4: US-29 Deploy API and website on Render
column5:
As the developer, I want the API and website deployed on Render so that anyone can use the portal by a link.

Acceptance criteria:
Render web service builds from GitHub on every push; Express serves the pages and the API; secrets set as environment variables.

Owner: Member 3
Reviewer: Member 2

column4: US-30 Production config: HTTPS, CORS, environment secrets
column5:
As the developer, I want production settings configured so that the live site works over HTTPS.

Acceptance criteria:
Front end calls the API by relative URL; CORS limited to the site; JWT secret and DB password only in environment variables.

Owner: Member 1
Reviewer: Member 3

column4: US-31 Security hardening: rate limit, helmet, SQL checks
column5:
As the department, I want basic security hardening so that the portal is safe to use.

Acceptance criteria:
Login rate-limited (5 tries per 15 min); helmet headers on; all SQL parameterised; no secrets in the repository.

Owner: Member 5
Reviewer: Member 1

column4: US-32 Automated API tests with Jest and Supertest
column5:
As the developer, I want automated API tests so that business rules stay correct when code changes.

Acceptance criteria:
Jest + Supertest tests for submission, anonymity, status transitions, meetings and login; all pass.

Owner: Member 2
Reviewer: Member 4

column4: US-33 User acceptance testing on live site and bug fixes
column5:
As the product owner, I want user acceptance testing on the live site so that the release meets the SRS.

Acceptance criteria:
Test cases for every SRS requirement run on the live URL; failures logged as bugs and fixed.

Owner: Member 5
Reviewer: Member 4

column4: US-34 README, final API docs and user guide
column5:
As the instructor, I want complete documentation so that the project can be run and assessed.

Acceptance criteria:
README (setup, run, deploy), final API docs, short user guide for students and admins.

Owner: Member 3
Reviewer: Member 1

column4: US-35 Final report and presentation
column5:
As the student, I want the final report and presentation ready so that I can submit on time.

Acceptance criteria:
Report updated with final design, test results and screenshots; demo script rehearsed on the live site.

Owner: Member 1
Reviewer: Member 3
